title: RRB JE CBT-1 — Full-Length Junior Engineer Screening Mock Paper
subtitle: 100 Questions • 90 Minutes • 100 Marks • Official +1 / -0.33 (1/3rd) Marking
description: Exact full-length RRB Junior Engineer (JE) CBT-1 replica matching the official Railway CEN syllabus: Mathematics (30 Qs), General Intelligence & Reasoning (25 Qs), General Awareness (15 Qs), and 10th-CBSE General Science (30 Qs: Physics, Chemistry & Life Sciences) in 90 minutes.
instructions: Exact RRB JE CBT-1 pattern: 100 objective MCQs (100 marks) in 90 minutes composite duration.
Official sectional weights: Mathematics (30 Qs) • General Intelligence & Reasoning (25 Qs) • General Awareness (15 Qs) • General Science (30 Qs).
Official marking scheme: +1 mark for every correct answer and -1/3rd (-0.33) negative penalty for every incorrect answer.

questions.question: Simplify: $120 \div [15 + 3 \times (8 - 5)]$
What is the sum of the first 20 odd natural numbers?
questions.explanation: Sum of first $n$ odd natural numbers = $n^2 = 20^2 = 400$.

questions.question: Find the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of 72, 108, and 180.
questions.explanation: $72 = 36\times 2$, $108 = 36\times 3$, $180 = 36\times 5$. $\gcd(2,3,5)=1 \Rightarrow \text{HCF} = 36$.

questions.question: Which of the following fractions is the LARGEST?
Find the mean proportional between 16 and 25.
questions.explanation: Mean proportional = $\sqrt{16 \times 25} = 4 \times 5 = 20$.

questions.question: If $A$'s salary is 20% less than $B$'s salary, by what percentage is $B$'s salary more than $A$'s?
questions.explanation: Let B = 100, A = 80. Percent more = $\frac{20}{80} \times 100 = 25\%$.

questions.question: An engineer sells a multimeter for ₹1,380 at a 15% profit. What was its cost price?
A sum of ₹5,000 amounts to ₹6,200 in 3 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
Find the compound interest on ₹16,000 at 5% per annum for 2 years compounded annually.
15 technicians can assemble a relay panel in 12 hours. How many hours will 18 technicians take working at the same rate?
questions.explanation: $15 \times 12 = 18 \times H \Rightarrow H = 180 / 18 = 10$ hours.

questions.question: Pipe P fills a water tank in 12 minutes and Pipe Q fills it in 18 minutes. If both are opened together for 4 minutes and then P is closed, how many more minutes will Q take to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: Capacity = 36 units. P=3, Q=2. In 4 min: $4 \times 5 = 20$ units. Remaining = 16 units. Q takes $16/2 = 8$ min.

questions.question: A bullet train covers 450 km in 1 hour 30 minutes. What is its speed in m/s?
A motorboat travels 24 km upstream in 4 hours and 24 km downstream in 2 hours. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.explanation: Downstream = 12 km/h, Upstream = 6 km/h. Stream = $(12 - 6)/2 = 3\text{ km/h}$.

questions.question: Find the area of an equilateral triangle of side $12\text{ cm}$.
questions.explanation: $\text{Area} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} a^2 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 144 = 36\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.question: Find the curved surface area (CSA) of a cylinder of radius $7\text{ cm}$ and height $15\text{ cm}$ ($\pi = \frac{22}{7}$).
questions.explanation: $\text{CSA} = 2\pi rh = 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 15 = 660\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.question: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, its volume increases by how many times?
questions.explanation: $V \propto r^3$, so doubling $r$ increases volume by $2^3 = 8$ times.

questions.question: If $x + \frac{1}{x} = 4$, find the value of $x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}$.
What is the remainder when $f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 + 4x + 5$ is divided by $(x - 2)$?
questions.explanation: By Remainder Theorem: $f(2) = 8 - 12 + 8 + 5 = 9$.

questions.question: Find the distance between points $A(2, 3)$ and $B(10, 9)$.
The angle subtended by a chord at the centre of a circle is $110^\circ$. What is the angle subtended by the same chord at any point on the major arc?
questions.explanation: Angle at circumference = half the angle at centre = $110^\circ / 2 = 55^\circ$.

questions.question: Evaluate: $\sin 60^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \cos 60^\circ \sin 30^\circ$.
questions.explanation: $\sin(60^\circ + 30^\circ) = \sin 90^\circ = 1$.

questions.question: If $\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = k$, what is the value of $5k + 3$?
questions.explanation: Since $\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = 1$, $k = 1 \Rightarrow 5(1) + 3 = 8$.

questions.question: A ladder $10\text{ m}$ long leans against a vertical wall making an angle of $60^\circ$ with the ground. How far is the foot of the ladder from the wall?
questions.explanation: Distance = $10 \cos 60^\circ = 10 \times 0.5 = 5\text{ m}$.

questions.question: Find the **range** of the dataset: `24, 15, 38, 19, 47, 12, 31`.
questions.explanation: Range = $\text{Max} - \text{Min} = 47 - 12 = 35$.

questions.question: Find the value of $\sqrt{1024} + \sqrt{196}$.
The sum of ages of A and B is 48 years. Six years ago, A was twice as old as B. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: 6 years ago sum = 36, ratio 2:1 ⇒ A was 24. Present age = $24 + 6 = 30$ years.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 8:20?
Find the 15th term of the Arithmetic Progression (AP): `5, 9, 13, 17, ...`
Two fair coins are tossed simultaneously. What is the probability of getting at least one Head?
questions.explanation: Outcomes: HH, HT, TH, TT. At least one Head = 3 out of 4 = $\frac{3}{4}$.

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is 42. Find the smallest of these numbers.
`Voltmeter : Voltage :: Galvanometer : ?`
questions.explanation: A Galvanometer detects and measures small electric currents.

questions.question:
Find the next term:
`6, 13, 27, 55, 111, ?`

Complete the series:
`Z, W, T, Q, N, ?`
questions.explanation: Each letter moves backward by -3: N(14) - 3 = K(11).

questions.question: In a certain code language, `SIGNAL` is written as `TJHOBM`. How is `TRACK` written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: T→U, R→S, A→B, C→D, K→L ⇒ `USBDL`.

questions.question:
If `P` means `÷`, `Q` means `×`, `R` means `+`, and `S` means `-`, evaluate:
`64 P 8 Q 5 R 12 S 7`
A woman introduces a man as the son of the brother of her mother. How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: Mother's brother is maternal uncle; his son is her **Cousin**.

questions.question:
Statements:
1. All engines are machines.
2. No machine is cheap.

Conclusions:
I. No engine is cheap.
II. Some machines are engines.
questions.explanation: Engines ⊂ Machines and Machines ∩ Cheap = ∅ ⇒ No engine is cheap (I) and Some machines are engines (II). Both follow.

questions.question: Which diagram best depicts: `Metals`, `Iron`, and `Chlorine`?
options: Iron completely inside Metals; Chlorine separate
questions.explanation: Iron is a metal (Iron ⊂ Metals), while Chlorine is a non-metal (separate circle).

questions.question: A surveyor walks 8 km West, turns right and walks 6 km North. How far is she from her starting point?
Select the odd one out.
questions.explanation: Ohm, Watt, and Volt are SI units; Resistor is an electronic component.
Cube relation: $5^3 = 125$, so $7^3 = 343$.

questions.question: In a line of 50 candidates, Pooja is 21st from the front. What is her position from the back?

Statement: Should all railway level crossings in India be replaced by Road Over Bridges (ROBs) or Road Under Bridges (RUBs)?
Arguments:
I. Yes, it eliminates unmanned/manned crossing accidents and improves train punctuality.
II. No, people enjoy waiting at closed railway gates.
questions.explanation: Argument I gives a concrete safety and efficiency rationale; Argument II is frivolous.

questions.question:
Question: On which day of the week did Amit visit the site?
Statements:
I. He visited after Wednesday but before Saturday.
II. He did not visit on Thursday.
options: Both I and II together are sufficient
questions.explanation: From I: Thursday or Friday. From II: not Thursday ⇒ definitively **Friday**. Both together are sufficient.

questions.question:
Find the missing number:
`4, 9, 25, 49, 121, ?`
questions.explanation: Squares of consecutive prime numbers: $2^2, 3^2, 5^2, 7^2, 11^2, 13^2 = 169$.

questions.question: If `GEAR` = 31 (sum of alphabetical values), what is `BOLT`?

Five engineers P, Q, R, S, and T sit on a bench facing North. P sits next to Q, R sits next to S, S does not sit with T who is on the left end of the bench. R is in second position from the right. P is to the right of Q and T. Who sits in the exact middle?
questions.explanation: T is 1st (left end), R is 4th (2nd from right), S is next to R and not next to T ⇒ S is 5th. P is next to Q and to the right of Q ⇒ Order: `T - Q - P - R - S`. Middle = **P**.

questions.question:
Statements:
1. Some wires are copper.
2. All copper are conductors.

Conclusions:
I. Some wires are conductors.
II. All conductors are copper.
questions.explanation: Wires that are copper are also conductors (I follows); II does not follow.

questions.question: Find the odd letter-cluster out.
questions.explanation: DFH, JLN, and PRT follow +2, +2 spacing; `VXY` follows +2, +1 (X to Y is +1).

questions.question: What time does a clock show in a mirror if the actual time is 9:15?
`Hygrometer : Humidity :: Seismograph : ?`
questions.explanation: A Seismograph detects and records seismic (earthquake) waves.

questions.question: A safety rule states: "Entry to the high-voltage substation requires BOTH an insulated helmet AND Class-0 rubber gloves." Ravi has an insulated helmet but forgot his rubber gloves. What should the supervisor do?
options: Deny entry until he wears Class-0 rubber gloves
Allow entry if he signs a paper
Let another worker hold his helmet
questions.explanation: Both mandatory PPE conditions must be satisfied simultaneously; hence entry must be denied.

questions.question: If `A > B`, `C < B`, and `D > A`, which of the following is the SMALLEST?
questions.explanation: Order: `D > A > B > C`. Smallest is **C**.

questions.question:
Arrange the engineering workflow in logical sequence:
1. Testing  2. Design  3. Deployment  4. Requirement Analysis  5. Fabrication
questions.explanation: Requirement Analysis (4) → Design (2) → Fabrication (5) → Testing (1) → Deployment (3).

questions.question:
Find the missing number:
`10, 14, 23, 39, 64, ?`
Who is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: Under Article 53(2), the supreme command of the Defence Forces of the Union is vested in the President.

questions.question: The Western Ghats (Sahyadri) and Eastern Ghats meet at which hill range?
questions.explanation: The Nilgiri Hills form the junction of the Western and Eastern Ghats in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka.

questions.question: Who founded the Indian National Army (Azad Hind Fauj) in Singapore / revitalized it with the slogan 'Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom'?
questions.explanation: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose reorganized the INA in 1943 and gave the historic call 'Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom'.

questions.question: Which institution regulates and supervises the securities and stock markets in India?
questions.explanation: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), granted statutory powers in 1992, regulates capital markets.

questions.question: What is the name of India's indigenous regional satellite navigation system developed by ISRO?
questions.explanation: NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation / IRNSS) provides accurate positioning across India and 1,500 km beyond its borders.

questions.question: Which greenhouse gas is the primary contributor to anthropogenic global warming?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) accounts for the largest share of human-induced radiative forcing.

questions.question: Kathakali is a classical dance-drama originating from which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Kathakali is a classical dance-drama of Kerala distinguished by elaborate makeup and facial expressions.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is an international team championship associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: India won its maiden Men's Badminton Thomas Cup title in Bangkok in May 2022.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees Right to Constitutional Remedies and was called the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution' by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar?
questions.explanation: Article 32 empowers citizens to move the Supreme Court directly for enforcement of Fundamental Rights.

questions.question: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Bandipora district, Jammu & Kashmir (fed by the Jhelum) is India's largest freshwater lake.

questions.question: What is the name of India's indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system designed by RDSO to prevent rail collisions?
questions.explanation: Kavach (SIL-4 certified ATP system) automatically applies brakes if a loco pilot fails to respond to red signals or overspeeds.

questions.question: Nalanda Mahavihara, the renowned ancient residential university in Bihar, was founded during the reign of which Gupta ruler?
questions.explanation: Emperor Kumaragupta I founded Nalanda University in the 5th century CE.

questions.question: National Science Day is celebrated across India on 28 February every year to commemorate:
options: Discovery of the Raman Effect by Sir C. V. Raman
questions.explanation: Sir C. V. Raman announced the discovery of the Raman Effect on 28 February 1928 (Nobel Prize in Physics, 1930).

questions.question: Which body recommends the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for 22 mandated agricultural crops in India?
questions.explanation: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) recommends MSPs, approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA).

questions.question: The Montreal Protocol (1987) was signed internationally to phase out substances responsible for:
options: Depletion of the stratospheric ozone layer
questions.explanation: The Montreal Protocol successfully phased out CFCs and halons to heal the Earth's ozone layer.

questions.question: Two resistors of $6\,\Omega$ and $3\,\Omega$ are connected in parallel across a $12\text{ V}$ battery. What is the total current drawn from the battery?
questions.explanation: Equivalent resistance $R_p = \frac{6\times 3}{6+3} = 2\,\Omega$. Current $I = V/R_p = 12/2 = 6\text{ A}$.

questions.question: What is the power (in Dioptres) of a convex lens having a focal length of $+25\text{ cm}$?
A body of mass $4\text{ kg}$ moves with a velocity of $5\text{ m/s}$. What is its kinetic energy?
Which rule is used to determine the direction of the force experienced by a current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field (electric motor principle)?
questions.explanation: Fleming's Left-Hand Rule gives the direction of force (motor), while Fleming's Right-Hand Rule gives induced current (generator).

questions.question: What is the audible frequency range for a healthy young human ear?
questions.explanation: Human hearing spans roughly 20 Hz to 20 kHz (below 20 Hz = infrasonic; above 20 kHz = ultrasonic).

questions.question: If an object weighs $60\text{ N}$ on Earth, what will its approximate weight be on the surface of the Moon?
questions.explanation: Lunar gravity is $\frac{1}{6}$th of Earth's gravity: $60 / 6 = 10\text{ N}$ (mass remains constant).

questions.question: At what temperature do the Celsius and Fahrenheit scales read the exact same numerical value?
questions.explanation: Solving $C = \frac{5}{9}(C - 32)$ gives $C = F = -40^\circ$.

questions.question: Which type of mirror is used as a rear-view mirror in automobiles because it always forms a virtual, erect, diminished image with a wider field of view?
questions.explanation: Convex mirrors diverge rays to offer a wide field of view with upright images.

questions.question: According to Joule's Law of Heating, the heat $H$ produced in a resistor $R$ carrying current $I$ for time $t$ is given by:
questions.explanation: Joule's Law: $H = I^2 R t$.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of magnetic flux density (magnetic field strength $B$)?
questions.explanation: Magnetic field $B$ is measured in Tesla ($\text{T} = \text{Wb/m}^2$); magnetic flux is Weber.

questions.question: In the Modern Periodic Table, elements are arranged in increasing order of their:
questions.explanation: Henry Moseley established that properties of elements are a periodic function of their atomic number ($Z$).

questions.question: What colour does blue litmus paper turn when dipped into an acidic solution?
questions.explanation: Acids turn blue litmus red; bases turn red litmus blue.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of Plaster of Paris (calcium sulphate hemihydrate)?
questions.explanation: Heating Gypsum ($\text{CaSO}_4 \cdot 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$) at 373 K yields Plaster of Paris ($\text{CaSO}_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}\text{H}_2\text{O}$).

questions.question: Which process coats iron or steel with a protective thin layer of **Zinc** to prevent rusting?
questions.explanation: Galvanization coats iron with zinc, providing sacrificial cathodic protection against corrosion.

questions.question: What is the general molecular formula for the homologous series of **Alkenes** (containing one C=C double bond)?
questions.explanation: Alkanes: $C_nH_{2n+2}$; Alkenes: $C_nH_{2n}$; Alkynes: $C_nH_{2n-2}$.

questions.question: Which Group of the Modern Periodic Table contains the chemically inert Noble Gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn)?
questions.explanation: Group 18 elements possess completely filled valence shells (octet/duplet), making them inert.

questions.question: In the reaction $\text{Zn} + \text{CuSO}_4 \rightarrow \text{ZnSO}_4 + \text{Cu}$, which type of chemical reaction occurs?
questions.explanation: More reactive Zinc displaces less reactive Copper from copper sulphate solution (single displacement).

questions.question: Aqua Regia, capable of dissolving noble metals like gold and platinum, is a freshly prepared mixture of concentrated HCl and concentrated $\text{HNO}_3$ in the volume ratio:
questions.explanation: Aqua Regia consists of 3 parts concentrated HCl and 1 part concentrated $\text{HNO}_3$ ($3:1$).

questions.question: Bauxite ($\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3 \cdot 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$) is the principal ore of which metal?
questions.explanation: Aluminium is extracted commercially from Bauxite ore via the Bayer and Hall-Héroult processes.

questions.question: Which allotrope of Carbon is a good conductor of electricity due to delocalized free electrons between hexagonal layers?
questions.explanation: Each carbon in Graphite forms 3 covalent bonds, leaving 1 delocalized electron per atom to conduct electricity.

questions.question: Which vascular tissue in plants transports water and dissolved minerals upward from the roots to the leaves?
questions.explanation: Xylem conducts water and minerals unidirectionally upward; Phloem translocates prepared food (sucrose).

questions.question: How many chambers are present in the human heart?
questions.explanation: The human heart has 4 chambers (2 atria + 2 ventricles) to keep oxygenated and deoxygenated blood separate.

questions.question: During intense physical exercise in human skeletal muscles, anaerobic breakdown of pyruvate due to oxygen shortage produces:
questions.explanation: Lack of oxygen in muscle cells converts 3-carbon pyruvate into Lactic acid, causing muscle cramps.

questions.question: Which part of the human brain maintains posture, balance, and precision of voluntary muscular movements?
questions.explanation: The Cerebellum (in the hindbrain) coordinates balance, posture, and fine motor control.

questions.question: How many pairs of chromosomes are normally present in a human somatic (body) cell?
questions.explanation: Humans have 46 chromosomes arranged in 23 pairs (22 pairs of autosomes + 1 pair of sex chromosomes).

questions.question: Which component of human blood is primarily responsible for blood clotting at the site of an injury?
questions.explanation: Platelets release thromboplastin to initiate the fibrin clotting cascade.

questions.question: Night blindness (Nyctalopia) is caused by the deficiency of which vitamin?
questions.explanation: Vitamin A is essential for synthesizing rhodopsin in retinal rod cells.

questions.question: Which metal ion sits at the centre of the Chlorophyll molecule essential for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Magnesium ($\text{Mg}^{2+}$) is the central metal atom in the porphyrin ring of Chlorophyll (Iron is in Haemoglobin).

questions.question: Bile juice, which emulsifies dietary fats in the small intestine, is produced by the ______ and stored in the gallbladder.
questions.explanation: Bile is synthesized by hepatocytes in the Liver and concentrated/stored in the gallbladder.

questions.question: According to Lindeman's 10% Law of energy transfer in a food chain, if producers capture $10,000\text{ J}$ of solar energy, how much energy reaches the secondary consumers (3rd trophic level)?
questions.explanation: Producers (10,000 J) → Primary consumers (1,000 J) → Secondary consumers (**100 J**).
